title: User Segmentation
insights:
Dataset Summary

The dataset contains a total of 14,952 events recorded from 381 users over the period from November 27, 2025 to February 22, 2026. There are 109 unique event types within the application category.

User Segmentation Analysis

Using DBSCAN for clustering, two segments were identified, along with a group of outliers:

Segment: Outliers

Persona Name: "Outliers"

  • Profile: This segment consists of 19 users, representing 5.0% of the total user base. These users have an average of 333.7 events but a booking rate of 0.0%, indicating they did not complete any bookings.
  • Targeting Recommendation: Consider analyzing their behavior to understand why they engage heavily without converting. Tailor specific engagement strategies or surveys to gather insights.

Segment: Segment 0

Persona Name: "Casual Users"

  • Profile: This segment includes 362 users, making up 95.0% of the user base. They have an average of 23.8 events and also a booking rate of 0.0%, indicating no completed bookings.
  • Targeting Recommendation: Implement a campaign to encourage bookings, such as sending personalized offers or reminders based on their event interactions.

Overall Assessment

The user base appears to be struggling with engagement, as both identified segments show a 0.0% booking rate. The ratio of high-value users (those who complete bookings) to low-engagement users (those who do not complete bookings) is currently 0:381, indicating a significant opportunity for improvement in converting users into paying customers.
